name: Siswa masuk kelas dengan kode valid

planSteps.description: Verify the heading 'Masuk ke kelasmu' is visible
Fill the 'Kode kelas' input with HB2026 and the 'Namamu' input with 'Hikmal Ananta Putra', then click the button 'Masuk ke kelas'
Verify the URL becomes the student class dashboard (/siswa/kelas) and the heading shows the real class name 'Kelas Kesetaraan Harapan Bersama'
Verify the class dashboard shows the class code HB2026 and a list of bab cards (e.g. 'Menemukan gagasan utama')
